buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Item’s Requirement: Hydroxy Terminated Poly Butadiene (HTPB) is required for Qty- 15338 k g as per Specification No. HEMRL/TRIM/PROP/RM/4 (Revised) [Note: Bid is published with item des cription only and specification will be sent through email to interested bidders after receipt of Non disclosure agreement (NDA) [NDA attached with BidATC]. Interested bidders will have to submit N on disclosure agreement (NDA) on the following email id: ofipv@ord.gov.in to get the technical sp ecification. Offer of participated bidder(s) without submission of NDA will be rejected straightway.] 2. Delivery period/Schedule: Complete material quantity should be supplied within 16 mont hs (480 days) from the date of placement of supply order & the delivery schedule will be as per OFI requirements. [Note: Unloading at OFI stores godown will be in contractor’s scope.]

3. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Applicable for amount ₹10,23,490.00 , The quoti ng firm must upload scanned copy of EMD in the bid and forward the hard copy of th e same within 5 days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be treated as incompl ete & may lead to rejection of the bid. The MSE firms with valid UDYAM Registration Certificate, firms registered with Central Purchase organization, MoD or any Ordnanc e Factory, Central PSUs and verified startups are exempted from submission of EMD. EMD may be furnished in the form of Account payee Demand Draft/ Banker Cheque, Fixed Deposit Receipt from a Commercial Bank, Bank Guarantee from a Commercial Bank, Insurance Surety Bonds or online payment in an acceptable form safeguardi ng the purchaser’s interest in all respects. It should be drawn in the favour of Chief G eneral Manager. 4. Performance Security Deposit(PSD): Applicable @ 5% of total contract value ( Inclusive all). PSD should remain valid for a period of 60 days beyond the date of co mpletion of all contractual obligations of the supplier. Performance Security Deposit may be furnished in the form of Account payee Deman d Draft/ Banker Cheque, Fixed Deposit Receipt from a Commercial Bank, Bank Guara ntee from a Commercial Bank, Insurance Surety Bonds or online payment in an ac ceptable form safeguarding the purchaser’s interest in all respects. It should be draw n in the favour of Chief General Manager. PSD should be compulsorily in the form of B G/FDR/DD,Insurance Surety Bond from a Commercial Bank or online payment in a n acceptable form since it will also serve as financial guarantee against integrity pact . PSD in the form of Indemnity Bond will be accepted from central/state PSU. 5. Essential parameter of the tender for SDOTE case: Essential parameter of th e tender are as follows: i. The bidding firm must be an Original Equipment Manufacturer(OEM) not established at any Ordnance factory for supply of this material, si nce there is a specific requirement as per HEMRL SOP dt. 13/8/2025 stage I qualification, HEMRL will visit firm’s premises for P&M and faci lities for manufacturing of the subject item. ii. The firm must submit duly filled VRR Form along with bid iii. The supply should be strictly as per Item nomenclature/specification and required packing condition iv. Compliance of Inspection clauses v. Tender Enquiry Compliance Statement 6. Qualification Procedure for Source Development OTE: Stage-I: 180 Kg (free of cost) HTPB will be used for i) Evaluation of all test parameters as per specification at OFI and HEMRL, Pune. ii) Pilot batch processing at OFI for various composite propellant formulations for evaluating repeatability & reproducibility in mechanical properties, physical prop erties, NDT, ballistic properties as per test procedure for the specific propellant f ormulation. Stage-II: 540 Kg (free of cost) HTPB will be used for i) Full scale batch qualification at OFI for various composite propellant formulations fo r evaluating repeatability & reproducibility in mechanical properties, physical properti es, NDT, ballistic properties as per test procedure for the specific propellant formulati on.

ii) Aging study for various composite propellant formulations. The cost of other raw material and labour charges used in processing for above stages will be borne by OFI. Final Acceptance: Final acceptance & clearance will be given by HEMRL as per acceptance test parameters of respective propellant formulation based on whi ch OFI will give final clearance for bulk manufacturing. Note: i) Only one time trial will conducted for Stage-I/Stage-II. If the firm fails in either of th e stage, the tender will be short closed/terminated as the qualification (pilot/full scale ) is both material & labour intensive & otherwise it will affect the regular production a ctivities. ii) If firm fails in Stage I or Stage II qualification procedure, may be debarred for next two SDOTE cycle 7. Realistic Delivery Period for SDOTE case: Complete material quantity should b e supplied within 16 months from the date of placement of supply order & the deliver y schedule will be as per OFI requirements which are as follows: i. Firm has to supply 180 Kg HTPB free of cost for stage I qualification in first 02 m onths. ii. OFI qualification time for stage I: 03 months iii. Firm has to supply 540 Kg HTPB free of cost for stage II qualification: within 01 month after successful stage I qualification iv. OFI qualification time for Stage II: 04 months Further, upon successful Stage II qualification, 15338.000 Kg (tendered ma terial) HTPB to be supplied in next 06 months at a rate of approx. 2500.000 Kg per month. 8. VRRF and Capacity Verification are applicable and the same are as follow s: i. The bidding firm must be an Original Equipment Manufacturer(OEM) of th e subject item and not established at any Ordnance factory for supply of this m aterial. ii. The firm having one SDOTE supply order is not allowed to participate in other SDOTE for same item, floated by same or any other Factory. The quoting firm s hould submit an Undertaking stating their status in this regard. iii. Capacity Verification: Capacity verification will be done before acceptance of their technical offer. The capacity Verification (CV) of the firms short listed after scrutiny of the form filled in Vendor Registration Request Form (VRRF) will be ca rried out to access capacity and capability of the bidding firm for supply of the material. Standard fee will be charged. iv. VRRF: (a) VRRF will be available at the URL: https://vendor.munitionsindia.in/ for 15338.000 Kg quantity for the subject item and the bidding firms h ave to fill up the VRR Form and submit the same along with the bid. Th e bidding firm will also submit their last three year balance sheet alon g with VRR Form.

If online website is having any issue, then firm may submit VRRF offline. VRRF c opy is attached in BidATC and the bidding firms have to fill up the VRR Form an d forward the same along with the bid and a copy on email ID: ofipv@ord.gov.in . The bidding firm will also submit their last three year balance sheet along with VRR Form. Moreover, The application fee for registration shall be as under:- i) Large Scale Industries : Rs 10000 + 18% GST ii) Medium Scale Industries : Rs 5000 +18% GST iii) Small : Rs 3000 + 18% GST iv) Micro: Rs 2000 + 18% GST v) Authorised Dealers/Stockist/ Sole Selling Agents: Rs 3000 + 18% GST vi) For profile updation of registered vendor : Rs 3000 + 18% GST Payment against application fee for registration will be made on the following ac counts details and payment receipt copy submit along with the bid and a copy o n email ID: ofipv@ord.gov.in. Bank Name Account No. IFS Code Beneficiary Name Munitions India Limited State Bank of India 40465764516 SBIN0061534 , Ordnance Factory Itar si (b) The list of machinery etc. required for manufacturing and Testing/Inspection of “HTPB” for vendor registration is uploaded in Bid ATC document. v. Price bids of firms qualifying in Capacity Verification & whose technical offer is o therwise acceptable will be opened. vi. Freak Rates: Any quote that is less than 70% of simple average of the basic rat e (LTE and successfully executed vi. SDOTE/OTE) at which orders (excluding im port orders) have been placed over the preceding three years (reckoned from t he date of tender opening) shall be deemed as freak rate and liable to be reject ed vii. Tender Sample: applicable as per technical specification 9. Pre-qualification Criteria: The bidding firm must be an Original Equipment Manufac turer (OEM) of the subject item and not established at any Ordnance factory for suppl y of this material. 10. IP addresses collusion: this clause will not applicable for LTE case (as the case is being processed through email tender enquiry). Moreover, in SDOTE case, If IP Add resses found same for different bidders on GeM portal. Then, offers of the bidders wil l be summarily rejected on ground of suspected collusion. 11. Warranty: As per clause no. 8 given in Specification viz. 12 months from the date of receipt o f stores at consignee’s end (attached with bid documents). 12. Tender Enquiry Compliance Statement: Required as per attached Annexure-M 13. GST: The firms shall show applicable GST exclusively and as separate elements in their quotation as well as in their invoices. The firm shall submit the relevant docume

nts in support of the GST claim along with GST ID. OF Itarsi intends to avail GST input credit. The invoices are to be submitted ac cordingly. 14. Quantity Tolerance: Quantity tolerance of +/- 5% will be applicable. Payment will be made a ccordingly. 15. Pre-qualification Criteria: The bidding firm must be an Original Equipment Ma nufacturer (OEM) of the subject item and not established at any Ordnance factory for supply of this material 16. Special Note: a. Right of Access: Rep of OFI, OFI’s Customer, and other regulatory authorities shall h ave access to supplier’s facility and all other facilities involved in fulfillment of the Pur chase Order, where they shall have access to all procedures, practices, processes, ass ociated documents, and records related to quality assurance, quality control, and con figuration control. The supplier shall notify OFI in writing to any significant facility or or ganizational changes such as company name, location, or senior quality management . OFI reserves the right to audit for compliance of all the requirements. b. Record Retention: Supplier shall retain quality records for a minimum of 20 years fr om the date of acceptance in OFI in original form or in electronic form. The quality rec ords include COC, Test reports, Raw Material Test reports, Special Process certification s, Route cards (if applicable) and Calibration records. This data shall be made availabl e upon request. Records shall be appropriately identified, secured and stored properly to prevent deterioration or damage and to prevent loss. c. Disposition Requirement: Supplier shall ensure that non-confirming products are id entified and properly dispositioned as required by supplier’s procedures. Only product that confirms to specified requirements shall be shipped to OFI. Disposition of Use As I s or Repair for products shall require written authorization from OFI. OFI reserves the r ight to audit for compliance. Any reworked parts shall be re-inspected and / or tested prior to shipment. d. Prevention of counterfeit parts: The supplier shall have a program in place to prev ent delivery of counterfeit parts and materials to OFI. All parts, materials and assembl ies delivered to OFI shall be procured directly from OEM or their authorized dealers/dis tributors. If it is determined in a specific instance that this is not possible, the same to be intimated to OFI for their disposition. The supplier is responsible for the flow down of this requirement to its sub-tier vendors and their compliance to it. . 2. 3. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.
